dialogues.jp:
購買で買った月見特盛りうどんを手に、食堂に
いるはずの音夢を探す。
dialogues.en:
I looked for Nemu with a large-sized portion of udon in my
hand. She's supposed to be here in the cafeteria.
dialogues.text:
I looked for Nemu with a large-sized portion of udon in my
hand. She's supposed to be here in the cafeteria.

dialogues.jp:
それほど混み合っているというわけでもないが、
食堂の中で一人の人間を探すのは、骨が折れる
し腹も減る。
dialogues.en:
It isn't too crowded, but it's still hard to look for one
person. And it makes me hungry.
dialogues.text:
It isn't too crowded, but it's still hard to look for one
person. And it makes me hungry.

dialogues.jp:
特に、音夢みたいに大人しく食事をしているヤ
ツは見つけ辛い。
dialogues.en:
It's particularly hard to look for a person who's eating
quietly, like Nemu.
dialogues.text:
It's particularly hard to look for a person who's eating
quietly, like Nemu.

dialogues.jp: 「適当に座っちゃおうかな……」
dialogues.en: "Maybe I'll just sit down anywhere..."
dialogues.text: "Maybe I'll just sit down anywhere..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あ、兄さん！」
dialogues.en: "Hey, niisan!"
dialogues.text: "Hey, niisan!"

dialogues.jp:
ちょっと遠くからの声に周囲の視線が集まるが、
俺はそれらをさり気なく無視して片手を上げる。
dialogues.en:
People looked at us as she yelled out from across the room.
But I ignored it and raised my hand at her.
dialogues.text:
People looked at us as she yelled out from across the room.
But I ignored it and raised my hand at her.

dialogues.jp: 「なに食ってるんだ？」
dialogues.en: "What are you eating?"
dialogues.text: "What are you eating?"

dialogues.jp:
性格がうかがえるというのか、部屋の隅にいた
音夢の正面に腰をおろす。
dialogues.en:
It's just like her to sit in the corner of the cafeteria.I
sat down in front of her.
dialogues.text:
It's just like her to sit in the corner of the cafeteria.I
sat down in front of her.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ん。野菜サンドイッチと烏龍茶」
dialogues.en: "Well, a vegetable sandwich and oolong tea."
dialogues.text: "Well, a vegetable sandwich and oolong tea."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「それだけ？　もちっと食わないと身体がもた
　ないぞ。金がないなら貸すけど？」
dialogues.en:
"That's it? You need to eat more to keep up. Do you want me
to lend you some money?"
dialogues.text:
"That's it? You need to eat more to keep up. Do you want me
to lend you some money?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「そんな心配しなくても大丈夫。あんまりお腹
　空いてないから」
dialogues.en: "Don't worry about me. I'm not that hungry."
dialogues.text: "Don't worry about me. I'm not that hungry."

dialogues.jp: てへへへへ、と音夢が上品にパンをかじる。
dialogues.en: She smiled and ate her sandwich elegantly.
dialogues.text: She smiled and ate her sandwich elegantly.

dialogues.jp: 「だから胸も大きくならないんだな」
dialogues.en: "That's why your boobs won't grow as much."
dialogues.text: "That's why your boobs won't grow as much."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……兄さん、よほど叫びたいらしいわね」
dialogues.en: "....Fine. You're asking for it."
dialogues.text: "....Fine. You're asking for it."

dialogues.jp:
俺の足の上に、万力のような音夢の足がセット
される。
dialogues.en: Nemu placed her vice-like foot on top of my foot.
dialogues.text: Nemu placed her vice-like foot on top of my foot.

dialogues.jp: 「分かった。ごめん。まいった」
dialogues.en: "I see. I'm sorry. It's my bad."
dialogues.text: "I see. I'm sorry. It's my bad."

dialogues.jp: 両手を広げて、そのままうどんに手を伸ばす。
dialogues.en: I opened my arms, and started to eat my udon.
dialogues.text: I opened my arms, and started to eat my udon.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「でも、兄さんまでコッチ来ちゃっていいの？」
dialogues.en: "But, are you sure if it's OK for you to be here?"
dialogues.text: "But, are you sure if it's OK for you to be here?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「いいもなにも、別に悪いことはないだろう」
dialogues.en: "How can it be bad?"
dialogues.text: "How can it be bad?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「そうだけどさぁ……せっかく再会したって言
　うのに可哀想じゃないかな」
dialogues.en:
"Perhaps, but isn't it kind of a mean thing to do after all
these years?"
dialogues.text:
"Perhaps, but isn't it kind of a mean thing to do after all
these years?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ほうか？」
dialogues.en: "You think?"
dialogues.text: "You think?"

dialogues.jp: うどんを頬張りながら首をかしげた。
dialogues.en: I tilted my head while munching on my udon.
dialogues.text: I tilted my head while munching on my udon.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「そうだよぉ。せっかく私が気を｛つか／遣｝ってあげた
　のにさ……」
dialogues.en: "For sure. I tried to be considerate, you know?"
dialogues.text: "For sure. I tried to be considerate, you know?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「？　なんに気を遣ってたんだお前？」
dialogues.en: "What? What are you being considerate about?"
dialogues.text: "What? What are you being considerate about?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「ん……あっ、いや、なんでもないですよ〜
　だ！」
dialogues.en: "Well.... No. Never mind!"
dialogues.text: "Well.... No. Never mind!"

dialogues.jp: ぷぅ、と頬をふくらませて音夢が眉をよせる。
dialogues.en: She puffed her cheeks and frowned.
dialogues.text: She puffed her cheeks and frowned.

dialogues.jp:
「よく分からないヤツ……ま、どうせアレがさ
　くらんぼなら、別にこっちが行く必要なんて
　ないさ」
dialogues.en:
"I don't get it. But, if it was Sakura, then we don't have
to go to her anyway."
dialogues.text:
"I don't get it. But, if it was Sakura, then we don't have
to go to her anyway."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「どういうこと？」
dialogues.en: "What do you mean?"
dialogues.text: "What do you mean?"

dialogues.jp: ずずず、と椀を口元によせてため息をつく。
dialogues.en: I sipped some soup from the bowl, and sighed.
dialogues.text: I sipped some soup from the bowl, and sighed.

dialogues.jp:
「どうしてか、かくれんぼでアイツに勝てた試
　しがないんだ……あんな風に」
dialogues.en:
"For some reason, I never could beat her in hide and seek...
Just like that."
dialogues.text:
"For some reason, I never could beat her in hide and seek...
Just like that."

dialogues.jp:
指差した食堂の入り口では、さくらんぼが団体
さんを引き連れて、きょろきょろと辺りを見渡
していた。
dialogues.en:
I pointed at the entrance of the cafeteria; Sakura was
looking around with a group of people behind her.
dialogues.text:
I pointed at the entrance of the cafeteria; Sakura was
looking around with a group of people behind her.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「あっ、こら、ボクはお兄ちゃんを探してるだ
　けで、そんなのいらな――うぎゃ〜！」
dialogues.en:
"Hey! I'm just looking for oniichan and I don't need that.
No!!"
dialogues.text:
"Hey! I'm just looking for oniichan and I don't need that.
No!!"

dialogues.jp:
餌付け感覚なのか、さくらんぼに食べ物をあげ
ようと皆が寄りそって渦を形成している。
dialogues.en:
Everybody's surrounding Sakura trying to feed her. Is it
kind of like the feeding of a monkey or something?
dialogues.text:
Everybody's surrounding Sakura trying to feed her. Is it
kind of like the feeding of a monkey or something?

dialogues.jp: ……あれは今度、飼育部に預けよう。
dialogues.en:
... Maybe I should ask the breeding club to take care of her
next time.
dialogues.text:
... Maybe I should ask the breeding club to take care of her
next time.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「卒業間近だっていうのに、これから大変だね」
dialogues.en: "You'll be in trouble right before graduation."
dialogues.text: "You'll be in trouble right before graduation."

dialogues.jp:
残ったサンドイッチを無理やり口に詰め込んで、
音夢が意味深な瞳を俺に向ける。
dialogues.en:
Nemu gave me a look as she pushed the rest of the sandwich
into her mouth.
dialogues.text:
Nemu gave me a look as she pushed the rest of the sandwich
into her mouth.

dialogues.jp: 「……とりあえず俺は消える」
dialogues.en: "I'll go for now."
dialogues.text: "I'll go for now."

dialogues.jp:
両手の指を組んで人差し指だけを立てて、机の
下に沈んでいく。
dialogues.en: I locked my fingers like a ninja and went under the table.
dialogues.text: I locked my fingers like a ninja and went under the table.

dialogues.jp: 「にんにん」
dialogues.en: "Nin Nin..."
dialogues.text: "Nin Nin..."

dialogues.jp: ◆食堂でかくれんぼ◆
dialogues.en: ◆Playing hide and seek in the cafeteria◆
dialogues.text: ◆Playing hide and seek in the cafeteria◆

dialogues.jp:
食堂で音夢を見つけ一緒に昼飯を食べる。なに
か雰囲気がおかしいが、どうやらさくらに気を
遣っているらしい。
dialogues.en:
I found Nemu in the cafeteria and we ate lunch together.
She's acting weird but I guess she's trying to be
considerate to Sakura.
dialogues.text:
I found Nemu in the cafeteria and we ate lunch together.
She's acting weird but I guess she's trying to be
considerate to Sakura.

dialogues.jp:
そんな拗ねた可愛さに思わず笑みを浮かべてし
まうと、音夢は頬をふくらませるのだった。
dialogues.en:
I thought the way she was being sulky was really cute, but
Nemu puffed her cheeks instead.
dialogues.text:
I thought the way she was being sulky was really cute, but
Nemu puffed her cheeks instead.
